question: The _______ committee was set up to make recommendations about the fundamental duties.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaran Singh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swaran Singh committee** was set up in **1976 **to make recommendations about the** fundamental duties** of Indian citizens.
 
• The committee was constituted by the then **Prime Minister, Indira Gandhi, **and was headed by **Swaran Singh,** who was the Minister for Law and Justice at that time.
 
• The committee submitted its report in** 1978**, which recommended the inclusion of** ten fundamental duties** in the Constitution of India.
 
• These fundamental duties were later added to the Constitution through the** 42nd Amendment Act of 1976.**
 
• The fundamental duties aim to promote** patriotism, **respect for the Constitution and national symbols, and a** sense of responsibility** towards society and the environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Balwant Ray Mehta committee:**

 
 
• It was set up in **1957 **to examine the working of the **Community Development Programme (CDP) **and the National Extension Service (NES) in India.
 
• The committee recommended the establishment of a** three-tier Panchayati Raj system in India.**
 
 
 
• **Swaminathan committee:**
 
 
• It was set up in **2004** to address issues related to **farmers' distress and suicide** in India.
 
• The committee recommended several measures to improve the condition of farmers, including **debt relief, crop insurance, and minimum support prices for agricultural produce.**
 
 
 
• **Bibek Debroy:**

• He has authored several books and articles on **economic policy and reforms** in India.
